q: In which solution were the stalks firmest?
More salt, softer, more floppy stalks.
Explain why the stalks in 5% salt went limp.
Water left the cells by osmosis: the cells lost turgor (pressure), so they could not support the stalk.
These results are descriptions, not numbers. Suggest how to make them quantitative.
Measure the angle the stalk bends when held at one end, or the mass change, so results can be compared and averaged.
